title: Prana country profile
description: Country-specific labelling conventions, stored at data/countries/<code>.json. This is the file a fork replaces to target a different country, so it must contain everything that is country dependent and nothing that is not.

barcode_prefixes.description: GS1 prefixes normally issued in this country, for example 890 for India. A hint for identification only. A prefix does not prove where a product was made, and it is never presented to the user as if it did.

default_nutrition_basis.description: What labels in this country normally declare. Used to warn about an unusual record, never to assume a missing basis.

sodium_declared_as.description: Indian labels usually declare sodium, European labels usually declare salt. Converting between them is arithmetic we may only do when we know which one the packet stated.
